issue: New public type OrderProcessor has no XML documentation comment.
New public method ProcessOrder has no XML documentation, and its parameter names 'amt' and 'tx' do not convey their meaning (amount and tax rate).
New public method ProcessRefund has no XML documentation, and its parameter names 'amt' and 'tx' do not convey their meaning.

The name ProcessRefund misleads: the method performs exactly the same positive-total calculation as ProcessOrder, with no sign inversion or refund-specific behavior, so nothing distinguishes it as a refund operation.
suggestion: Either document explicitly that the returned value is a positive refundable amount (e.g. "/// <returns>The positive, tax-inclusive amount to be refunded to the customer.</returns>") or rename the method to reflect that it simply computes a tax-inclusive total (e.g. CalculateTaxInclusiveTotal).
